title: Ambitious climate action will reap large dividends for Cabo Verde
temporal_coverage: Current vulnerabilities and GDP/tourism projections through 2050
methodology: World Bank official CCDR summary page describing sectoral exposure and headline projections.
limitations: Summary page omits assumptions behind 2050 estimates.

title: Cabo Verde Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0 (NDC)
temporal_coverage: Historical climate trends over approximately 50 years; current vulnerability assessment
methodology: Government NDC summarizing historical climate analysis and differentiated vulnerability assessments.
limitations: The cited vulnerability passages are national diagnostics; station-level and group-level methods are not detailed there.

title: Cabo Verde: Increasing Resilience to Disasters and Climate-Related Shocks
temporal_coverage: World Bank-supported disaster-risk reforms reported for 2018–2022
methodology: World Bank results brief describing a policy-financing operation and reported outputs.
limitations: Institutional achievements are publisher-reported results; the page does not provide an independent counterfactual evaluation.
